# AGOT: The Long Night & Azor Ahai -- ORIGINALLY GENERATED by ln-audit-tools/gen_ln_rules.py.
#
# 1.1.0a -- THE GENERATOR IS NOT ON DISK ANY MORE (it lived in a session scratch dir; nothing under
# mod/_tools/ carries it). Until it is rebuilt this file is hand-maintained: on an AGOT update, re-copy
# their is_alliance_valid body and re-apply the NOR clause below by hand. Do not "regenerate" from a
# script that does not know about the clause.
#
# 1.1.0a -- LOAD ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING FOR THIS FILE. Scripted rules resolve by name, one definition per
# playset, last parse wins. Legacy of Valyria - AGOT 0.5.1 ships its own is_alliance_valid
# (common/scripted_rules/00_rules.txt:490), and so do Princes of Darkness, LotR: Realms in Exile and
# Elder Kings 2. If any of them loads after us, everything below is discarded silently -- no error, no
# warning, and the dead can ally again. The same is true of our other two rules that collide with LoV
# (is_character_allowed_to_be_player, has_natural_death_second_chance -- and that second one is the whole
# entry point to the last kiss). CHECK logs/database_conflicts.log AFTER EVERY PLAYSET CHANGE: it must
# name OUR file as the most recent definition of all three.
#
# The belt to this file's braces is ln_the_dead_employ_nobody_effect (zz_ln_service_effects.txt), which
# breaks the dead's alliances once a year regardless of who won the parse.
# AGOT's is_alliance_valid, taken verbatim from their common/scripted_rules/00_rules.txt (0.5.1),
# with one NOR clause added at the top. Do not hand-edit: regenerate after every AGOT update so their
# changes to the rest of the rule flow straight through.
#
is_alliance_valid = {
	# ── NOTHING ALIVE KEEPS AN ALLIANCE WITH THE DEAD (11 Aug) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
	# Workshop report: "the others should probably not be able to have allies, it doesn't make sense for the
	# Lord of the Stormlands to side with the dead like it happened in my game."
	#
	# The raise-time sweep in mutate_into_other_effect severs alliances a wight held IN LIFE. It cannot cover
	# an alliance formed afterwards, cannot cover an ally already called into a war, and never covered the
	# Night King, who is excluded from that effect by design. CK3 re-checks this rule on existing alliances,
	# so one clause here severs anything standing AND blocks anything new. Mid-save safe: an alliance with the
	# dead simply lapses.
	# 1.1.0a -- WAS FOUR has_trait LINES (other_trait / wight_trait, on each side), AND THAT IS TWO OF THE
	# SEVEN THINGS THAT MAKE SOMEBODY ONE OF THE DEAD. ln_is_one_of_them_trigger
	# (zz_ln_ice_dragon_triggers.txt:82) also counts the ln_one_of_them stamp, nightking, house_theothers,
	# ruins_government and wight_government -- and a lord raised by mutate_into_other_effect carries the
	# government while often carrying no trait at all (the 1.0.6a finding, in that trigger's own header).
	# So the ban had a hole exactly the shape of a converted lord, in both directions: he could keep an
	# alliance he made in life and form new ones after death. Thomas's 1 Sep screenshot shows the Night
	# King's side of a Long Night war carrying an ally; this is the road that was open.
	# `?=` on scope:second so a missing scope fails OPEN and the rule keeps AGOT's answer.
	NOR = {
		ln_is_one_of_them_trigger = yes
		scope:second ?= { ln_is_one_of_them_trigger = yes }
	}
	#AGOT Disabled
	# NOT = {
	# 	has_title = title:h_china
	# }
	OR = {
		any_spouse = {
			this = scope:second
		}
		betrothed = scope:second
		is_parent_of = scope:second
		is_child_of = scope:second
		is_sibling_of = scope:second
		is_grandparent_of = scope:second
		is_great_grandparent_of = scope:second
		is_grandchild_of = scope:second
		is_great_grandchild_of = scope:second
		is_uncle_or_aunt_of = scope:second
		is_nibling_of = scope:second
		has_relation_blood_brother = scope:second
		scope:second = {
			OR = {
				has_opinion_modifier = {
					modifier = perk_negotiated_alliance_opinion
					target = root
				}
				has_opinion_modifier = {
					modifier = event_negotiated_alliance_opinion
					target = root
				}
			}
		}
		#childhood friendship with hostage event, where they swear to be friends forever
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_relation_friend = scope:second
				has_relation_best_friend = scope:second
			}
			OR = {
				any_memory = {
					memory_type = hostage_oath_of_friendship
					has_memory_participant = scope:second
				}
				scope:second = {
					any_memory = {
						memory_type = hostage_oath_of_friendship
						has_memory_participant = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# FP3 struggle case
		#AGOT Disabled
		# has_character_flag = fp3_is_a_loyalist_puppet
		# scope:second = { has_character_flag = fp3_is_a_loyalist_puppet }
		#AGOT Added
		house ?= {
			house_head ?= PREV
			any_house_relation = {
				any_relation_house = {
					exists = house_head
					scope:second = house_head
				}
				has_house_relation_parameter = unlocks_house_head_negotiate_alliance
			}
		}
	}
}
